source.name: Big Jaw Bite
source.originalDescription: The user becomes Unstoppable while letting out an intimidating growl, reducing move cooldowns by 40% of the remaining cooldown, and reduces move cooldowns by 40% of the max cooldown for future move uses while this move is active for up to 15s. Additionally the user's tenacity is increased by 30% for 15s. When this move is used again, the user becomes Unstoppable and charges at the designated Pokémon from the opposing team and sinks their teeth into them, dealing damage. The amount of damage dealt is based on the number of Fang marks applied by Crunch. Buffs: 50% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Big Jaw Bite は 妨害無効になる、与ダメージを変化させる、シールドを付与する、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、再使用・派生・2段目を持つ。
